The questions point to broad aspects (sensitivity, theoretical/topological justification, application to network representation) but the comment merely poses two open questions, with no details on what specific theoretical or topological content should be added, where, or how to perform the requested analysis. As a result, the authors would not know exactly how to carry out the revision. Thus, the comment describes an implicit action that is vague on implementation, matching the lower end of the rubric rather than the level requiring concrete implementation details.
